dt: Forecast posted Jul 30, 2026; est. NOFO post May 27, 2027; est. due Oct 4, 2027; est. award Jul 1, 2028
e: NIH plans a trans-NIH parent R35 that funds an investigator's whole research program within an institute's mission, rather than a single project, at any career stage including Early Stage Investigators. US universities may apply; the forecast is expected to be the investigator's main funding from the awarding institute.
n: NIH Parent R35 Investigator-Focused Award (PAR-28-037) - forecast
unv: Forecast only: award size, budget limits and which institutes take part are not given yet.
